Package cp

Class ArcConsistency

java.lang.Object
cp.ArcConsistency
public class ArcConsistency extends Object
Implements the Arc Consistency (AC) algorithm to enforce consistency on a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP).

This class supports both binary and unary constraints, verifying that each variable's domain contains only values that satisfy the constraints with respect to the domains of other variables. It offers methods for arc consistency (AC1) and node consistency.

    • ArcConsistency

      public ArcConsistency(Set<Constraint> constraints)
      Constructs an ArcConsistency instance with a given set of constraints. Constraints must be either unary or binary.
      Parameters:
      constraints - The set of Constraint instances to be checked.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a constraint is not unary or binary.

  • Method Details

    • revise

      public boolean revise(Variable variable1, Set<Object> domain1, Variable variable2, Set<Object> domain2)
      Enforces arc consistency between two variables by revising domain1 of variable1.

      This method removes values from domain1 that do not have a corresponding "support" value in domain2 (i.e., values in domain1 that cannot satisfy the constraints with any value in domain2).

      Parameters:
      variable1 - The first Variable in the constraint.
      domain1 - The domain of variable1.
      variable2 - The second Variable in the constraint.
      domain2 - The domain of variable2.
      Returns:
      true if values were removed from domain1; false otherwise.

    • ac1

      public boolean ac1(Map<Variable,Set<Object>> domains)
      Applies the AC-1 algorithm to enforce arc consistency on all variables and domains in the CSP.

      The method iteratively enforces consistency between pairs of variables until no more values can be removed. It also applies node consistency on all variables before beginning arc consistency checks.

      Parameters:
      domains - A map representing the domains of each variable in the CSP.
      Returns:
      true if arc consistency was successfully enforced; false if any domain becomes empty.

    • enforceNodeConsistency

      public boolean enforceNodeConsistency(Map<Variable,Set<Object>> domains)
      Enforces node consistency on all variables by ensuring that all values in each variable's domain satisfy unary constraints.

      The method iterates through each variable and removes values from its domain that do not satisfy unary constraints, if any are present.

      Parameters:
      domains - A map representing the domains of each variable in the CSP.
      Returns:
      true if node consistency was successfully enforced; false if any domain becomes empty.
